- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2033 (also 2029-2054, 2198, 2213, 2391; tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:745 vs :766) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The handoff flag is checked first in review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed, so it short-circuits the numeric-run-id, BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS, RUN_STATUS, inactivity and step-stall checks. It is set on every path where require_bait_review_coverage returns 1, including the `not_covered` path that appends the same run to BAIT_UNCOVERED_RUN_IDS. It is cleared only when a later poll reports a numeric run id.
  WHY: An uncovered run keeps the phase waiting past the base deadline, and an in_progress run with `unknown` coverage skips both backstops. The phase then fails at the ceiling (job start plus 215 minutes) instead of at 90 minutes, which delays the release-gate failure by up to about 125 minutes. No false pass is possible. Test :766 asserts the behaviour that :745 contradicts.
- changelog.d/8004-phase4-review-deadline-extension.md:14-15 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Line 14 says the wait is extended "only while" the run is numeric, covers the bait and has an eligible status. Line 15 says the wait continues after the loop drops the watched run, which line 14 excludes.
  WHY: The changelog misstates the implemented wait bound that readers rely on when diagnosing a Phase 4 timeout.

  Evidence of absence: The PR changed files contain no `agents.d/` path, and `agents.d/` has no `8004-*` fragment. The prefix appears only at .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2228, in the test and in the changelog fragment. The heal scope excludes `agents.d/`, so the deliverable is neither landed nor explicitly deferred in the PR body. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
